title: EXTREME OPTIMIZing
body:
**EXTREME OPTIMIZing** is a Fabric performance modpack built for one purpose — to make Minecraft run the way it should. No bloat, no fluff. Just raw, optimized, silky-smooth gameplay.

What's inside the modpack

Sodium — obliterates the vanilla renderer and replaces it with something actually fast
Lithium — supercharges game logic, AI, and physics under the hood
C2ME — spreads chunk loading across ALL your CPU cores. No more stutters.
FerriteCore — slashes RAM usage so your game breathes easy
EntityCulling + MoreCulling — why render what you can't even see?
ImmediatelyFast, Krypton, VMP, Noisium — every millisecond counts

And that's not even all of it. 52 mods working together so you don't have to think about it.
